title: Team Falcons secures Grand Finals berth in MPL PH S18

blocks.text: Team Falcons Philippines secured a ticket for the M8 World Championship, as well as their grand finals slot for the MPL Philippines season 18 after surviving Aurora Gaming Philippines in the upper bracket finals, 3-2, at the Philippine Sports Arena on Friday, October 23.
